name: Tides Reach Guest House

dogs: Welcome in Oyster Cottage; ask about the guest rooms

overview: Tides Reach is a guest house on Mumbles Road, facing the promenade and Swansea Bay and a few minutes' flat walk from Mumbles. There are five individually designed rooms and a two-bedroom self-catering cottage next door. Caswell Bay is a short drive west along the coast.
surfTripFit: It has free parking and breakfast, and you're close to Mumbles for food, with Caswell and Langland a short drive away.
